recordGovernance.loadFailed: Failed to load record governance settings
recordGovernance.levelMetadataOnlyDesc: Only metadata such as model, status code and latency is recorded; request and response bodies are not stored.
recordGovernance.levelSummaryDesc: In addition to metadata, truncated request/response summaries are stored for quick triage without keeping full content.
recordGovernance.levelFullDesc: Full request and response bodies are stored, encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Viewing a record decrypts it on the server and writes a FULL_CONTENT_ACCESS audit event.
recordGovernance.fullConfirmMessage: The full content level stores request and response bodies encrypted at rest; viewing a record decrypts it on the server and records an audit event. Continue?
recordGovernance.storageHint: The key fingerprint helps verify that replicas share the same key; it does not reveal the key itself.
recordGovernance.fallbackTitle: Configured key source is not in effect
recordGovernance.fallbackDesc: The configuration requests an environment variable key, but the variable is unavailable, so the implementation fell back to an auto-generated file key. Check JAIR_CALL_HISTORY_KEY (Base64 encoded 32-byte key).
recordGovernance.auditDesc: At the full content level, viewing a record triggers server-side decryption and writes a FULL_CONTENT_ACCESS audit event (with operator and record identifiers).
